criteria.description: Evaluates against a recognized set of usability heuristics (Nielsen's 10 or equivalent), checking the interface against each principle systematically rather than listing a few ad-hoc opinions.
Rates each issue's severity (e.g. 0–4) so findings are prioritized, not a flat list.
Pairs each issue with a concrete, specific fix rather than vague advice like 'make it clearer'.
Catches issues specific to this page — e.g. 'delete account' needs confirmation/error-prevention, the long toggle list needs grouping/recognition, saving prefs needs status feedback.
Surfaces the most severe issues first / separates must-fix from minor.
